Checked on the build dev serves · 29 Oct

Public pages on phones

I went through every page you can reach without logging in, at 360 and 390px wide: the landing page, Pricing, About, Contact, Founders, Terms, Privacy, sign in and sign up. Nothing scrolls sideways and the landing hero holds up well. These are the fixes that would lift the rest. Each "Proposed" shot is the real page with the fix applied.

The hawk sits on the strapline

At 360px wide the hawk overlaps "No more winging it." on the opening drawer. Smaller, and set a little lower, it clears the words on every phone width.

360 × 780

Feature steps lose their "1 of 6" label

The progress bars above already say where you are, so the small capitals label goes. This follows your standing no-eyebrow rule.

390 × 844

"Founding writers" in plain case

The founding pill keeps its blush shape but reads in normal case at a readable size, on the landing page, Pricing, Founders and sign-up.

390 × 844

A footer half the length

The three link groups sit in two columns, and each link becomes a full 44px tap target (today they are 26px tall). The footer drops from about 1.5 screens to under one.

390 × 844

Pricing tabs you can read

"From £3.75 a month" is 8.6px capitals today. It becomes 13px in normal case.

390 × 844

Plan rows you can read

"£4.83 a month · save 40%" and "The monthly rate" are 9px capitals. They become 13px in normal case, so the saving is easy to see.

390 × 844

Contact form labels and button

Field labels move from small capitals to sentence case. The black "Send message" button becomes navy, like every other primary on the site.

390 × 844

Legal pages

"Legal · Terms" goes (the title says it). "Working draft" and "Last updated" move to readable sentence case.

390 × 844

The sign-up tab is cut off

At 360px the folder tab reads "Create ac…" behind "Back to site". On narrow phones the small "Your account" label goes, so "Create account" fits. The field labels move to sentence case.

360 × 780

Founders page labels

"The deal", "For your friends" and "A direct line" move to sentence case at 14px. The "For founding writers" eyebrow over the heading goes.

390 × 844

Also in the prompt

  • Tap targets. Small links get a 44px tap area without changing how they look: "Log in" in the nav, "Forgot?", "Back to site", "Which plan suits me best?", "Read our story", "How being a founding writer works" and the password eye.
  • The phone menu. It lists Features, About, Pricing, Contact and Log in, but not Founding writers. Add it, and end the menu with a "Become a founding writer" button.
  • Sign in and sign up links. Moving from #/login to #/signup on the same page keeps showing Sign in. The screen should follow the address.
  • Phones only. The desktop site stays exactly as it is. The same small capitals appear on desktop too; that is yours to decide separately.

Not design, but needs you before launch

  • Terms, Privacy and Contact still show "[LEGAL ENTITY NAME]" and "[REGISTERED / TRADING ADDRESS]". These come from src/lib/companyInfo.ts and need your real details.
  • About has four illustration placeholders ("The paper avalanche", "Reading the signs", "Minding the shop", "The founder's desk") waiting for your illustrator.
